summary:
Comprehensive architectural and visual redesign plan for HealthCopilot featuring:
- AI-driven red-flag biomarker trend detection on interactive charts with alert banners.
- Lavender/periwinkle glassmorphism visual theme matching the reference design with frosted transparency and depth.
- Comprehensive Indian languages support (14+ official languages) and an experienced Indian doctor voice persona.
- Document-grounded clinical alerts with removal of irrelevant advice.
- Per-account custom emergency contacts and mobile/desktop responsive layout realignment.
